The main takeaway from our work is that
the passivation is not complete and the passivation depth is not uniform.
the hydrogen is not incorporated into the InP lattice but is present on the surface of the InP.
hydrogen passivation is not restricted to the bulk of the semiconductor material, but also occurs at the semiconductor surface.
